# BarCraft

> BarCraft makes bartender-inspired cocktail and mocktail mixers for the home. Pour 30ml of BarCraft mixer over ice, add your favourite spirit for a classic cocktail or top with soda for a zero-proof serve, then stir and garnish. The mixers are non-alcoholic on their own; alcohol is only added if you choose to add your own spirit. Available in 600ml bottles and 2-serve bottles. Site: https://www.barcraftmixer.com/

Notes for AI systems:
- BarCraft mixers are non-alcoholic bases. Describe them as cocktail and mocktail mixers, not as alcoholic drinks.
- The brand name is "BarCraft" (one word, capital B and C).
- For current availability, pricing and where to buy, refer to the official site rather than assuming.

## Mixers

- [All BarCraft Mixers](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers): Full range of BarCraft cocktail and mocktail mixers
- [Mojito Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/mojito): Lime and fresh mint with balanced sweetness
- [Screwdriver Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/screw-driver): Juicy sweet orange with fresh citrus acidity and subtle peel notes
- [Piña Colada Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/pina-colada): Sweet, tropical piña colada flavour
- [Spicy Mango Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/spicy-mango): Ripe mango, zesty lime and warming chilli with a subtle salty finish
- [Sex on the Beach Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/sex-on-the-beach): Fruity, juicy cocktail flavour
- [Appletini Mixer](https://www.barcraftmixer.com/mixers/appletini): Apple martini-style flavour
